title: Live browser tool exposure and profile qualification
objective: Expose only live-qualified browser capabilities through Quntal's authoritative MCP tool contract and an explicit local `browser_structured` profile. No donor MCP server, raw browser API, arbitrary JavaScript/CDP, personal profile, or remote browser mapping may be exposed.

include: authoritative TOOL_CONTRACT entries for only those browser shapes proven live in SG-000075 through SG-000078
explicit `browser_structured` local tool-surface profile with default-deny membership and exact discovery tests
MCP schema, annotations, effect/approval classes, output bounds, and kernel-shape mappings derived from one source of truth
transport/profile tests proving stdio/loopback local exposure only unless a later grain authorizes remote mapping
end-to-end MCP -> quntald -> browser host tests for every exposed browser tool
parity inventory and generated documentation updates tied to live qualification state
negative discovery and invocation tests for every intentionally denied donor/browser capability
exclude: raw browser-host process or IPC controls
automatic inclusion in existing profiles by implication

authority_delta.filesystem: No authority beyond the live-qualified browser transfer tools already authorized in predecessor grains.
authority_delta.process: No new process authority; exposure does not widen browser-host control.
authority_delta.network: No authority beyond live-qualified governed browser navigation/transfer shapes.
authority_delta.browser: Selected live browser shapes become caller-accessible through Quntal's MCP contract under an explicit local profile.
authority_delta.ui_input: None beyond structured browser actuation already authorized; no OS input.
authority_delta.approval: Per-tool approval classes remain those of the underlying kernel shapes; exposure cannot weaken them.

invariants: tool exposure never outruns live provider qualification
Quntal TOOL_CONTRACT remains the only public tool-surface source of truth
browser_structured is explicit and local-only by default
denied donor capabilities remain absent from discovery and invocation

acceptance.claim: Every exposed browser tool has one exact TOOL_CONTRACT entry and one live provider path through quntald, and no non-live browser shape is discoverable.
The `browser_structured` local profile is exact, generated documentation/parity agree with discovery, and unknown/widened profiles fail closed.
Arbitrary JS/CDP, personal-profile, raw host control, non-qualified browser shapes, and remote browser mapping are absent from discovery and fail closed if invoked internally.
End-to-end local MCP tests prove policy, approvals, bounds, stale identity, cancellation, and evidence semantics are unchanged by exposure.
Exact-head CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, manual excluded-file review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000080: Desktop visual capture work may proceed independently after browser exposure is exact and canonically qualified.

done_when: Only live-qualified browser shapes are exposed through one exact local browser_structured profile, with denied donor/raw browser authority absent.
